name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the puncture and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the puncture stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the deep puncture and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the deep puncture stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to the stab wound and stop the bleeding.
success_msg: You apply pressure, and the flow of blood from the stab wound stops.

name: Staunch the bleeding
description: Use an absorbant material to apply pressure to your impaled limb and hope it stops the torrent of blood leaving your body.
success_msg: You spend a while applying pressure until the profuse bleeding is under control.

name: Flush the puncture
description: Use water to irrigate and wash out foreign contaminants from the puncture.
success_msg: You thoroughly flush your puncture with water to remove any foreign contaminants.

name: Flush the deep puncture
description: Use water to irrigate and wash out foreign contaminants from the deep puncture.
success_msg: You thoroughly flush your deep puncture with water to remove any foreign contaminants.

name: Flush the stab wound
description: Use water to irrigate and wash out foreign contaminants from the stab wound.
success_msg: You spend some time flushing out the stab wound to remove every last trace of contamination from the stab wound.

name: Flush your impaled limb
description: Use water to flush out every last trace of contamination from your impalement.
success_msg: You spend quite a while flushing water through the hole in your limb, knowing that anything less than full flush of all contaminants will kill you from sepsis from a puncture this severe.

name: Bandage the puncture
description: Use a bandage to cover and protect the puncture
success_msg: You cover the puncture with a bandage.

name: Bandage the deep puncture
description: Use a bandage to cover and protect the deep puncture
success_msg: You cover the deep puncture with a bandage.

name: Bandage the stab
description: Wrap the stab wound in a bandage to cover and protect it.
success_msg: You wrap a bandage around your stab wound.

name: Bandage the impalement
description: Use a bandage to protect the gaping hole in your limb from contamination.
success_msg: You spend some time wrap the impaled limb in a bandage and making sure none of the wounded flesh is exposed to foreign contamination.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your puncture.
success_msg: You remove the blood-stained bandage from your puncture and wrap a fresh one around it.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your deep puncture.
success_msg: You remove the blood-soaked bandage from your deep puncture and wrap a fresh one around it.

name: Change aging dressing
description: Swap out the dressing on your stab wound.
success_msg: You remove the blood-soaked bandage from your stab wound and wrap a fresh one around it.
